brief: Records what is supposed about a name, as an overlay on the world that WhatIs reads and that can be forgotten or committed.
detail: A supposition is the sentence Suppose X is a fruit: SupposeQ(name) builds it, IsAQ records the assumption and AndQ lets the sentence go on. The world of entities is not changed; WhatIs answers with the supposed types while they are held, ForgetSuppositions discards them and CommitSuppositions makes each one known to the world.
